goal: Make ArgsManager reject IsArgSet() calls on list-type options like -debug, -whitelist, -vbparams
Fixes a class of bugs where a negated list option is reported as 'set' even though it is empty, misleading callers
reviewability: Draft, stacked on two other long-open PRs (#16545, #17580) that provide the underlying type-flag machinery
Review the base PRs first since this PR's diff and behavior depend entirely on them landing or changing
agreement: Only one comment ever, a concept ACK from 2019 with no stated objections (promag)
No reviewer engagement since, so support is thin but there is no dispute either

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it closes a real bug class in ArgsManager where IsArgSet() lies about list options being set, a pattern the description says caused bugs later fixed in #30529
Also has leverage: it's the last piece of a years-long stacked project (#16545, #17580) adding typed ArgsManager flags that other args-related PRs build on

result.summary: This PR is the final commit in a long-running stack (based on #16545 and #17580) that adds typed ArgsManager flags (ALLOW_BOOL/INT/STRING/LIST) and, in its headline change, makes it a logic_error to call IsArgSet() on an ALLOW_LIST option. It also fixes several call sites (-onlynet, -testactivationheight, -vbparams) that were relying on the old, confusing IsArgSet-on-list behavior, and updates the fuzz harness and unit tests to match the new API surface. The PR has been continuously rebased for over six years to track conflicting PRs and upstream changes.
result.problem: Calling IsArgSet() on a list-type option can return true even when the list is empty (e.g. when the option was negated), which is confusing and has caused real application bugs; the description cites #30529 as a PR that fixed a number of such bugs downstream of this exact pattern.

resolved_concerns: No substantive objections raised; single concept ACK from promag in 2019 stands unchallenged

result.card: This PR is the top of a years-long stack (based on open PRs #16545 and #17580) that finishes adding typed ArgsManager flags and makes it an error to call IsArgSet() on list-type command-line options, fixing a real bug pattern: 'IsArgSet() with list options is confusing and leads to bugs when IsArgSet() returns true, but GetArgs() returns an empty list' (description), a pattern the author says caused bugs later fixed in merged PR #30529. It touches shared ArgsManager code (Utils/log/libs) and is P2 there for correctness and leverage, but has essentially no independent standing in build, tests, validation, or wallet since those files only get mechanical follow-on edits. Review is best done starting from the unmerged base PRs #16545/#17580, since this PR's diff and behavior are inseparable from theirs and have been rebased 26 times over six years. Agreement is thin but uncontested: a single 2019 concept ACK from promag with no subsequent reviewer engagement or objections. The author remains active, force-pushing rebases as recently as August 2026, but no substantive review has occurred in over six years.
